subject: Re: White Mountain Glitch
author: ZombieTron
body:
The white mountain glitch is a place on the track where if you crash there you respawn quite a distance up the road making the race alot shorter. If you use this on purpose to gain position or a better lap time it is cheating. But that is what people are talking about. 🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---
